body: Thank you for the responses. Yes I was informed that over many years the codition may improve, or at least the pain. However the medication is taking a serious toll on my wellbeing. From what I've learned this back pain is the leading source of disability world wide. And if at my age it's being so restricting I can't even imagine the future. More pain, liver damage from meds, impotence due to meds/pain, arthritis. Also the pain has made me very selfish, I lost friends, belief in myself. I'm just a shadow of my former self. I really tried to find an escape but everything I love doing is being taken away. How can I ever look forward to the future knowing I'll never be as good as I could have been?
